{{Quote|Greetings, Skanditos! How are things here in the holes?|Bondo, upon meeting the Skandits|<ref name="Jindas">{{Ewoks|The Curse of the Jindas}}</ref>}}
The '''Skandits' home''' was a forest clearing on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] where a large band of [[Skandit]]s lived. They brought [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] there, keeping them in cells dug out from the roots of trees and secured with wooden doors. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Skandits captured several [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and brought them to their home. They later received the [[Travelling Jindas]], led by [[Bondo]], and agreed to let the itinerant entertainers perform for them. During the performance, the Ewoks escaped their imprisonment and the fled with the Jindas into the forest.
